about.h2: A neighbourhood gym where the owner still coaches.
about.p1: Max Fitness Gym has been part of Nyay Khand since 2000. Members come for the equipment and stay for the people: trainers who notice your form, remember your name and push you just enough.
about.p2: Whether you're lifting for the first time or chasing a new personal best, the floor is set up to help you train safely and keep coming back.
about.beginners: Beginners guided from the first session
about.photoMain: Wide view of the training floor
about.photoInset: A trainer guiding a member's form

facilities.h2: Everything you need, nothing you don't.

strength.name: Strength zone
strength.body: Machines, free weights, benches and full mirrors for form checks.

cardio.name: Cardio zone
cardio.body: Treadmills and recumbent bikes for warm-ups, fat loss and endurance.

functional.name: Functional floor
functional.body: Battle ropes, step platforms and agility cones on an open wooden floor.

supplements.title: Supplements, from the counter you already trust
supplements.body: Whey, mass gainers, creatine and the everyday basics — kept at reception and sold to members. Ask the desk what is in stock and what it costs; your trainer will tell you honestly whether you need it before they sell you anything.
supplements.point1: Genuine, sealed products — bought at the gym, not forwarded from a link.
supplements.point2: Advice first: your trainer looks at your diet plan before suggesting anything.
supplements.point3: Members' prices. Ask at the desk, or on WhatsApp.

bot.title: WhatsApp assistant
bot.notAllowed: Only the owner can set up the assistant.
bot.noKey: No AI key is configured yet, so the assistant cannot answer anybody. You can still write what it should know and set it up — it starts answering the day the key is added.
bot.switchesHelp: Two switches on purpose: you can set it up and try it without it speaking to a single member.
bot.isActiveHelp: Off means it does nothing at all, anywhere.
bot.autoReplyHelp: Off means it only answers you, here, in the test box below.
bot.personaHelp: A line or two. "Warm, short sentences, never pushy" is plenty. This goes to the assistant with every message.
bot.escalationLabel: When it cannot answer, what should the member be told?
bot.escalationHelp: A number to ring, a name to ask for, or "come to the desk".
bot.knowledgeHelp: The assistant answers only from what is written here — prices, timings, rules, payment, renewals, trials, the usual questions. If something is not here, it says it will ask a person instead of making it up.
